PDF.js Canvas + SVG Text layer annotations
Caches full PDF binary blobs on disk

99.9% Cache Hit Ratio on static bundles
Directs requests to closest edge node
• Extracts binary bytea buffer from PostgreSQL
• Manages 63 curated ambient, focus, cinema, sleep tracks
• IFrame bridge: dispatches postMessage to hidden YouTube player
• Zero host audio egress: audio stream is 100% outsourced
• YouTube Global CDN delivers audio stream direct to Client DAC
• Step 1: Receives 1MB binary slice via multipart FormData
• Step 2: Writes temporary slice into NoteUploadChunk table
Fetches all chunks sorted by index in single transaction
• Step 4: Writes unified file to NoteFile & purges temp chunks
• Executes server-side Prisma queries during request
Bypasses serverless ephemeral disk constraints by assembling
PDF chunks directly in RAM and persisting as native bytea.
• Handles binary bytea streaming from PostgreSQL
Encryption: AES-256 at Rest & in Transit
Direct Bytea: Zero external S3 cost
Both relational records & PDF files in one DB
⚡ [D] DIRECT YOUTUBE AUDIO STREAM (0 KB/s SERVER EGRESS)
[G1] Git Push Webhook -> Vercel Edge Deploy
WHY THIS ARCHITECTURE EXCELS ON FREE-TIER INFRASTRUCTURE

1. YouTube audio bridge avoids gigabytes of bandwidth bills | 2. 1MB chunking bypasses serverless payload caps | 3. Immutable caching cuts database read traffic by 95% | 4. Neon PostgreSQL bytea eliminates AWS S3 bucket fees
